name: Aurore Lalucq - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive amending Directive 2011/16/EU on administrative cooperation in the field of taxation
part_text:
The European Parliament approves, without changes, a proposed law on how tax information is shared between EU countries. The aim is to make life easier for big multinational company groups that must report how much tax they pay under the global minimum tax rules agreed in 2022. Instead of every company in a group filing separately in its own country, one company can file for the whole group using a standard form. Tax authorities would then exchange that information with each other.

- One company can file tax information for the whole group, using a standard form.
- It affects large multinational groups and big domestic groups, cutting their paperwork.
- EU countries must adopt it quickly so the first filing, due by 30 June 2026, can use the simpler rules.
